landscapeChanges.name: Manus
landscapeChanges.detail: Meta acquired the Chinese-founded agentic-AI platform for $2B in Dec 2025; China's NDRC ordered the deal unwound in Apr 2026 over foreign-investment rules, Meta cut Manus off from its internal systems in June 2026 and required deletion of user data created since 29 Dec 2025 by 24 Aug 2026, and Manus is reverting to independent operation.
landscapeChanges.notes: Directory should flag this as an unstable/high-churn agentic tool rather than a dependable long-term OSINT resource.

landscapeChanges.name: Yupp
landscapeChanges.detail: Crowdsourced AI-model comparison/leaderboard service (1.3M users, $33M a16z-crypto seed) shut down on 31 Mar 2026, citing failure to reach product-market fit as agentic AI systems evolved.

landscapeChanges.name: Sentinel-1A
landscapeChanges.detail: Sentinel-1A, the longstanding C-band SAR satellite, was retired on 29 June 2026 after 11 years in orbit; Sentinel-1C/1D now form the operational pair on the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem.

landscapeChanges.name: RiskIQ PassiveTotal
landscapeChanges.detail: The standalone RiskIQ/PassiveTotal community platform is effectively dead (broken logins, expired/mismatched TLS certs); its passive-DNS successor Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence is itself being retired and folded into Defender XDR as an enterprise-only add-on around August 2026, removing the free/community access path entirely.

landscapeChanges.name: Open Ownership Register
landscapeChanges.detail: The public Open Ownership Register prototype was closed on 29 November 2024; Open Ownership shifted to publishing raw BODS beneficial-ownership datasets for download/reuse rather than hosting a live public search register.

landscapeChanges.name: Pushshift
landscapeChanges.detail: Public API access was revoked in May 2023 after Reddit's API pricing changes; access is now restricted to verified subreddit moderators only and is not available for general OSINT use.

landscapeChanges.name: PullPush
landscapeChanges.detail: The Pushshift-replacement API stopped ingesting new Reddit data around May 2025 and has since suffered repeated outages (HTTP 502s in July 2026, HTTP 429 refusals in Aug 2026), making it effectively unreliable for current research.

landscapeChanges.name: Unddit / Camas
landscapeChanges.detail: Both Reddit deleted-comment viewers are dead; their domains no longer resolve.

landscapeChanges.name: Removeddit
landscapeChanges.detail: The domain has been hijacked and now redirects to an unrelated online casino affiliate site; use Reveddit instead.

landscapeChanges.name: TweetDeck / X Pro
landscapeChanges.detail: On March 26, 2026, X moved X Pro (formerly free TweetDeck) from being included with the $8/month Premium plan to being locked behind the $40/month Premium+ tier, a fivefold price increase applied without advance notice; X has signaled X Pro will eventually be replaced by a new tool.

landscapeChanges.name: X Ads Repository
landscapeChanges.detail: X publishes only downloadable CSV files for its DSA-mandated ad repository, with no query API; the European Commission fined X EUR 120 million on Dec 5, 2025 partly over this repository's unreliable search and failures to grant researcher data access under DSA Art. 40(12).

landscapeChanges.name: OSINT Combine free tools

landscapeChanges.name: Chainalysis Free Tools
landscapeChanges.detail: Chainalysis no longer offers a public free tier; Reactor, KYT, and Kryptos are sold exclusively as quote-based enterprise subscriptions priced by seats, blockchain coverage, and transaction volume.
